proposals.observation: 14 of 15 quiz sessions stalled at intro_load and never advanced. Only 1 reached email_shown, and 0 completions were recorded. The intro screen is the entire drop-off point — the copy or the primary CTA is not compelling enough to push the tap/click that starts the quiz proper.
proposals.proposal: Rewrite the quiz intro headline and sub-copy to name the exact tension the ICP is sitting with — earning well but not building — and replace any abstract framing with a direct, grounded prompt. The CTA button text should describe the result of starting, not the act of starting.
proposals.current_text:
Find out your money personality
Discover how your relationship with money shapes every financial decision you make.
[Start the quiz]
proposals.new_text:
What's the story beneath why you're not building?
You earn well. You're switched on. The money still doesn't stick — and you already know it's not a spreadsheet problem. This takes four minutes.
[Show me what's underneath]
proposals.impact: Reduces intro-to-step-1 drop-off from ~93% toward a viable funnel

proposals.observation: Three GitHub Actions workflows — Daily Blog Post, Weekly Monday Report, and Funnel-Hack Digest — all failed in the last 24 hours. The content queue has only 1 post queued against 21 published, meaning the pipeline is effectively dry. No new blog content will be published until the workflow is repaired.
proposals.proposal: Inspect the most recent failed run log for Daily Blog Post (the highest-cadence failure, failed 2026-05-04T10:34:20Z) and patch the single breaking line. The most common cause in Astro/Node content pipelines is a missing env secret or a changed API response shape. Add a null-guard or restore the secret, then re-run manually to confirm green.
proposals.current_text:
- name: Generate post
  run: node scripts/generate-post.js
  env:
    OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
proposals.new_text:
- name: Generate post
  run: node scripts/generate-post.js
  env:
    OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
  continue-on-error: false
- name: Verify output
  run: |
    if [ ! -f "$(ls src/content/blog/*.md 2>/dev/null | tail -1)" ]; then
      echo "::error::Post generation produced no output file" && exit 1
    fi
proposals.impact: Restores daily content publishing and prevents further queue starvation

proposals.observation: The Money Vigilance automation has the highest open rate of the three sequences at 50% (4/8 opens), yet it has the lowest send volume — 8 against 15 and 16 for the other two. This suggests the Vigilance segment is under-trafficked relative to its engagement quality. The quiz currently sends zero completions, so the only source of sequence entrants is organic or direct. A high-performing sequence starved of entrants is a leverage point.
proposals.proposal: Add a standalone in-text CTA block to the most recent blog post (family money boundary post, published 2026-05-03) that explicitly routes readers who recognise the 'quiet background monitoring, the checking, the not-quite-trusting' pattern into the quiz with a Vigilance-primed framing. This costs one file edit and targets the ICP's self-identification instinct without naming the segment label.
proposals.current_text: If any of this resonates, you might find it useful to take the free quiz and see what pattern is driving your decisions.
proposals.new_text: If you noticed a low-level tension while reading this — not panic, just a steady background hum of 'I need to be careful, I need to track this, I can't quite let go of the numbers' — that's worth turning toward. That pattern has a shape, and understanding it is more useful than another boundary script. [Four-minute quiz — what's the thing underneath your money decisions?](/quiz)
proposals.impact: Routes self-identifying Vigilance readers into the quiz, feeding the highest-engagement sequence
